notes: Identity verified from article title, all four named authors, DOI 10.1177/1747021817744546, journal 2018 volume 71(12), pages 2506–2519. Supplied canonical text is a full primary research article with Experiment 3 methods/results and references, not an abstract or secondary report. No source PDF path supplied. Unassigned fields and replication are null placeholders; no replication source inspected. Assigned beta (std) metric and graph-literacy description identify the graph-literacy regression coefficient (β=.22, t=3.23, p=.001), rather than the separately labelled Pearson correlations. The full model includes display dummies, graph literacy and interactions. Its final sample is explicitly 611, with reported analyses retaining the full sample. Bars-only correlation n=202 is a separate test, not the assigned beta coefficient. No N derived from df or summed.
